title: Oil seals and top-cover seals in a spheroidising annealing furnace with a bottomless muffle
summary: A tight lid alone does not establish the sealing of a bottomless muffle retort. Suneng's proposal for spheroidising annealing of bearing-steel wire coils describes two separate arrangements: the retort bottom inserted into an oil-seal trough, and a clamped lid at the furnace-mouth flange. Both have specified cooling provisions. Check each seal, its cooling and its abnormal-condition signals separately; one component in position or one temperature alarm does not prove that the whole retort has passed a seal test.
